title: carpesium nepalense var. ciliatum
intro: Carpesium nepalense var. ciliatum, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the Asteraceae family, is a variant of Carpesium nepalense. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Carpesium nepalense var. ciliatum include its ability to modulate immune responses, exhibit neuroprotective effects, and demonstrate anti-cancer properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to fully understand the pharmacological effects of this plant and its potential applications in medicine.
